name: file-budget
description: Stops the same unchanged file from being read into the conversation twice, and says what a large read is about to cost.

large_file_tokens.title: Large-file threshold (tokens)
large_file_tokens.description: Reads expected to cost more than this get a note saying what they cost and how to ask for less. The read itself always goes through.

dedupe_window_minutes.title: Duplicate-read window (minutes)
dedupe_window_minutes.description: How long a file counts as already-read. Older entries expire, so a long session can re-read a file it has genuinely lost track of.

enforcement.title: Enforcement level
enforcement.description: 'block' refuses a duplicate read of an unchanged file. 'warn' only explains. 'off' disables the guard.
